q: Ek BankAccount class likho jisme balance ho, deposit aur withdraw method ho.
Ek Rectangle class likho jisme area aur perimeter nikalne ke methods hon.
Ek Student class likho jisme name, marks hon aur grade nikalne ka method ho.
Ek Circle class likho jisme radius ho aur area, circumference nikalne ke methods hon.
Ek Animal base class aur Dog, Cat classes likho jinme apna apna sound ho (inheritance).
Ek Counter class likho jisme increment, decrement aur reset ho.
Ek Inventory class likho jisme items add karo, quantity update karo aur total value nikalo.
